display.purpose: The page's single h1. An <em> inside it is set in the spot colour, not italicised.

headline.purpose: Section headings inside a ruled head block, column 2 beside the margin designator.

title.purpose: Step instructions and the end-of-procedure line. Archivo Narrow sets anything that tells the reader to do something.

lede.purpose: The one paragraph under the display line. Max 34ch, opening to 48ch below 1040px.

body.purpose: Step notes, captions, section sub-lines, part descriptions, index entries.

label.purpose: Functional uppercase labels: field tags, table headers, plate tags, the document line. Never a kicker above a heading.

designator.purpose: JetBrains Mono, tabular. Reference designators, values with units, figure and sheet numbers, counts. Never a texture for 'technical'.

shadows.name: plate-lift
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system. Lifts a mounted figure plate off the stock, which is what a mounted plate physically does. No other component gets a shadow.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The system's only easing curve. Exponential ease-out from an already-visible default.

motion.name: trace-ease
motion.purpose: Used only by the schematic's wire trace, where a line draws itself in the order a person would wire it.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover colour and background changes on rows, chips and buttons.

motion.name: link
motion.purpose: Nav underline wipe and the action-row chevron nudge.

motion.name: stock-flip
motion.purpose: The stock switch's corner turning over.

motion.name: tick
motion.purpose: The checkbox tick struck in left to right via stroke-dashoffset.

motion.name: cut
motion.purpose: A clip crossfading inside the lead plate.

motion.name: slide
motion.purpose: A completed assembly crossfading inside the wide plate.

motion.name: trace
motion.purpose: The full schematic trace, started once on intersection.

motion.name: current
motion.purpose: The only looping motion sanctioned anywhere in the system: current running in the schematic, as a dash offset.

motion.name: plate-hold
motion.purpose: How long one completed assembly holds before advancing. Stops permanently on first pointer contact.

components.name: Step Row
components.description: A numbered instruction in the margin column with a drawn checkbox. The signature control of the page: ticking it scrubs the film, and the running film ticks it.
components.css: .ds-steps { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule-2, #BFB6A2); } .ds-step { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-2, #BFB6A2); } .ds-do { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px 22px 1fr; align-items: start; gap: 14px; width: 100%; padding: 15px 0; text-align: left; background: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; color: inherit; } .ds-no { padding-top: 3px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.74rem; color: var(--ink-3, #6B6A5E); transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-box { position: relative; width: 22px; height: 22px; border: 1.5px solid var(--rule, #17181C); background: var(--mount, #FBF9F4); } .ds-box svg { position: absolute; inset: 2px; width: calc(100% - 4px); height: calc(100% - 4px); fill: none; stroke: var(--spot, #0050DC); stroke-width: 2.4; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-say { display: grid; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; } .ds-say b { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.012em; } .ds-say i { font-style: normal; font-size: 0.86rem; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--ink-3, #6B6A5E); } .ds-step[data-here='true'] .ds-no { color: var(--spot, #0050DC); } .ds-step[data-here='true'] .ds-box { border-color: var(--spot, #0050DC); } .ds-do:hover .ds-box { border-color: var(--spot, #0050DC); } .ds-do:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--spot, #0050DC); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Action Row
components.description: The primary action, continuing the step list rather than sitting in a band. Unnumbered, an arrow in the margin column, a filled box as its hit target. It never ticks.
components.html: →Open the editor.No account needed to try it.
components.css: .ds-act { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px 22px 1fr; align-items: start; gap: 14px; padding: 15px 0; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; } .ds-act-no { padding-top: 3px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--spot, #0050DC); } .ds-act-box { position: relative; width: 22px; height: 22px; border: 1.5px solid var(--spot, #0050DC); background: var(--spot, #0050DC); } .ds-act-box::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 6px; top: 50%; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-top: 2px solid var(--mount, #FBF9F4); border-right: 2px solid var(--mount, #FBF9F4); transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(45deg); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-act:hover .ds-act-box::after { transform: translate(3px, -50%) rotate(45deg); } .ds-act-say { display: grid; gap: 3px; } .ds-act-say b { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.012em; color: var(--spot, #0050DC); } .ds-act-say i { font-style: normal; font-size: 0.86rem; color: var(--ink-3, #6B6A5E); } .ds-act:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--spot, #0050DC); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Figure Plate
components.description: The load-bearing device of the system: mount, 1.5px frame, 10px inset, caption rule, mono figure number in the spot colour. It is what lets a dark render sit on warm paper.
components.css: .ds-plate { margin: 0; } .ds-mount { position: relative; padding: 10px; background: var(--mount, #FBF9F4); border: 1.5px solid var(--rule, #17181C); box-shadow: 0 10px 26px -14px var(--sunk, rgba(22,23,27,0.14)); } .ds-art { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; background: var(--plate-dark, #0E1014); } .ds-plate figcaption { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 9px; padding-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule-2, #BFB6A2); font-size: 0.82rem; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--ink-2, #55564E); } .ds-plate figcaption b { flex: none; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--spot, #0050DC); }

components.name: Locate Field
components.description: The parts-list search. A square ruled box on mount with a mono uppercase tag fused to its left edge.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; align-items: center; flex: 1 1 320px; max-width: 460px; border: 1.5px solid var(--rule, #17181C); background: var(--mount, #FBF9F4); } .ds-field:focus-within { border-color: var(--spot, #0050DC); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--spot, #0050DC) 20%, transparent); } .ds-field-tag { flex: none; align-self: stretch; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 0 11px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.66rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3, #6B6A5E); border-right: 1px solid var(--rule-2, #BFB6A2); } .ds-field input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 11px 12px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--ink, #16171B); font: inherit; font-size: 0.96rem; outline: none; caret-color: var(--spot, #0050DC); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3, #6B6A5E); } .ds-clear { padding: 0 11px; font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--ink-3, #6B6A5E); background: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-clear:hover { color: var(--ink, #16171B); }

components.name: Try Chip
components.description: A suggested search value. Set in mono because its label is a value, not a word. Never filled at any state; selection moves text and border to the spot colour.
components.css: .ds-try { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; } .ds-try button { padding: 5px 10px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.74rem; color: var(--ink-2, #55564E); background: none; border: 1px solid var(--rule-2, #BFB6A2); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-try button:hover { color: var(--ink, #16171B); border-color: var(--ink-3, #6B6A5E); } .ds-try button[data-on='true'] { color: var(--spot, #0050DC); border-color: var(--spot, #0050DC); } .ds-try button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--spot, #0050DC); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ruled Table Row
components.description: A row of the parts list. A list of buttons, not a table: each row is a thing you press. The header carries the only 1.5px rule in the block.
components.html: PartDescription
components.css: .ds-th { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 15rem) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 26px; padding: 0 0 7px; border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--rule, #17181C); font-size: 0.66rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3, #6B6A5E); } .ds-table ul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-tr { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 15rem) minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 26px; width: 100%; padding: 10px 0; text-align: left; background: none; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-2, #BFB6A2); cursor: pointer; font: inherit; color: inherit; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-name { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-width: 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; letter-spacing: -0.008em; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-name i { flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--ink-2, #55564E); } .ds-name span { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-desc { font-size: 0.86rem; color: var(--ink-3, #6B6A5E); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-tr:hover { background: var(--stock-2, #EAE4D6); } .ds-tr:hover .ds-name, .ds-tr:hover .ds-name i { color: var(--spot, #0050DC); } .ds-tr:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--spot, #0050DC); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Section Head
components.description: A ruled head block with its designator in the margin column. Without the designator in the gutter the section is a hero band with manual decoration on it.

components.css: .ds-head { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: baseline; column-gap: 14px; row-gap: 8px; padding-bottom: 26px; border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--rule, #17181C); } .ds-head h2 { grid-column: 2; margin: 0; font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 2.3rem; line-height: 1.04; letter-spacing: -0.022em; } .ds-head p { grid-column: 2; margin: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-size: 0.86rem; color: var(--ink-3, #6B6A5E); } .ds-sect { grid-row: 1 / span 2; grid-column: 1; padding-top: 0.5em; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--spot, #0050DC); } .ds-fig-no { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 400; color: var(--spot, #0050DC); } .ds-dot { width: 3px; height: 3px; background: var(--rule-2, #BFB6A2); }

components.name: Stock Switch
components.description: Flips between paper and the blueprint negative. A sheet corner that turns over, not an icon and not a toggle track.
components.css: .ds-stock { position: relative; width: 30px; height: 22px; border: 1.5px solid var(--rule, #17181C); background: var(--mount, #FBF9F4); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; } .ds-stock span { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--rule, #17181C); clip-path: polygon(100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); transition: clip-path 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-stock:hover span { clip-path: polygon(100% 0, 0 0, 0 100%); } .ds-stock:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--spot, #0050DC); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Account Button
components.description: The app shell's rounded pill, restyled rather than forked, so it reads as a drawn control like every other box on the sheet.
components.css: .ds-acct { height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1.5px solid var(--rule, #17181C); border-radius: 0; background: var(--mount, #FBF9F4); color: var(--ink, #16171B); font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-acct:hover { background: var(--spot, #0050DC); border-color: var(--spot, #0050DC); color: var(--mount, #FBF9F4); } .ds-acct:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--spot, #0050DC); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Plain ruled links in the title block. Hover wipes a 1.5px spot underline in from the left.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 20px; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: 2px 0; font-size: 0.86rem; color: var(--ink-2, #55564E); text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -2px; height: 1.5px; background: var(--spot, #0050DC); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: 0 50%; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--ink, #16171B); } .ds-nav a:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--spot, #0050DC); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
This is the printed manual that comes in the box with a kit of parts — the Heathkit/Dynaco register, not a nostalgic pastiche of it. The page does not describe a procedure, it is one: a title block with a sheet number, numbered steps with real checkboxes down a ruled margin, figure plates with caption rules, a parts list with a header row, and a final instruction at the end of the procedure. Every surface built in this world should be legible as a page of the same document.

The material is warm stock, not white and not grey. There is one ink — a near-black line — and one spot colour, carried by the brand blue. Structure is drawn: two rule weights, a frame around every plate, a strict margin column down the left. Nothing is shaded, gradient, blurred or glassy; depth comes from rules and from the mount a plate sits on. Density is close: a 1px rule between list rows, 10px of mount around a photograph, 14px between the margin column and the text it labels.

The two stocks are the one genuinely unusual move, and the one most likely to be misread. data-sheet='paper' and data-sheet='blue' are not a light theme and a dark theme. They are one drawing printed two ways: paper, and the blueprint negative. The geometry, the rule weights, the stroke widths, the spacing and every component are byte-identical between them; only the ink and the ground swap. That is why they are one attribute on a root element rather than a second set of components, and any new surface must work the same way — if you find yourself writing a rule that applies only to one stock, the rule is wrong.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground (#F2EEE4), near-black line, one spot colour, nothing else
Spot colour rationed to what is live; never decorative
Flat ink only: no gradient, no glass, no soft card, no tint fill for mood
Structure drawn with rules at exactly two weights (1px and 1.5px)
Zero corner radius everywhere, including on controls borrowed from the app shell
A strict 28px margin column that every designator sits in
One shadow in the entire system, and it lifts a mounted plate
Monospace reserved for designations and measurements

rules.name: The Live-Ink Rule
rules.body: The spot colour marks something that is live: current flowing, a control that acts, a step not yet done, a designator. Nothing is spot-coloured for emphasis, for mood, for a section accent, or to make a page feel branded. If you cannot name what is live about the element, it is not blue. This is the hardest rule in the system and the easiest to erode; audit test — point at any blue pixel and say what it is live about in four words.

rules.name: The Two-Stocks Rule
rules.body: paper and blue are one drawing printed twice. Ink and ground swap; geometry, rules, weights and spacing never do. No component may have a stock-specific layout, size, shadow or extra element. The only sanctioned per-stock divergence already in the build is --plate-dark, which stays dark on both because the photograph it backs is dark on both.

rules.name: The Two-Inks Rule
rules.body: There are two inks and no more. A third hue — a warning amber, a success green, a second accent — is outside the system. State that needs to be distinguished is distinguished by weight, by rule, by strike-through or by position in the margin column.

rules.name: The Designator Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for designations and measurements only — reference designators, values with units, figure and sheet numbers, quantities, counts. It is never a texture applied to make something feel technical. Prose in mono, a heading in mono, or a button label in mono is a violation; the one button set in mono is the try-this chip, and it is set that way because its label is a search value (555, 10k), not a word.

rules.name: The Narrow-Instructs Rule
rules.body: Archivo Narrow sets instructions and headings. Anything that tells the reader to do something is Narrow; anything that explains is Archivo. Do not reach for Narrow to tighten a long paragraph.

rules.name: The Margin Column Rule
rules.body: Every designator — step number, section number, figure number, action arrow — sits in the 28px margin column, and every body element on the page starts at calc(var(--gut) + var(--marg) + 14px). A section head without a designator in the gutter is a hero band with manual decoration on it; the designator is what makes the rest of the sheet part of the same document. Never express the column in ch.

rules.name: The One-Shadow Rule
rules.body: The plate lift is the system's whole shadow vocabulary. A new component does not get a shadow. If something needs to read as separate, rule it or mount it.

rules.name: The Flat-Ink Rule
rules.body: Nothing is a gradient and nothing is glass. No tinted overlay for mood, no frosted chip floated over artwork, no soft card. Flat ink on stock.

rules.name: The Two-Weights Rule
rules.body: 1px for division, 1.5px for structure. A third rule weight is not available; if a boundary needs more presence, it is structural and takes 1.5px.

rules.name: The Mounted-Plate Rule
rules.body: Every photograph and every render on this page goes inside a plate: mount, 1.5px frame, 10px inset, caption rule, mono figure number in the spot colour. A dark image placed directly on the stock splits the page in two. Never paint the plate dark over the mount; the dark goes inside the mount.

rules.name: The Drawn-Control Rule
rules.body: Controls are drawn with the sheet's own line: a square, a 1.5px frame, a mount fill, and a stroked SVG mark where a mark is needed. No icon font, no glyph character standing in for a control, no filled pill, no rounded corner.

dos: Do ration the spot colour to what is live — current, a control that acts, a step not yet done, a designator — and nothing else.
Do put every designator in the 28px margin column and start every body element at calc(var(--gut) + var(--marg) + 14px).
Do mount every photograph or render in a figure plate with its caption rule and a mono figure number in the spot colour.
Do use exactly two rule weights: 1px hairline for division, 1.5px for structure.
Do keep geometry, weights and spacing identical across the two stocks, and swap only ink and ground.
Do set designations and measurements in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures, and nothing else in mono.
Do draw state — a strike-through, a stroked tick, a filled box, a rule — rather than tinting a surface to signal it.
Do keep a single looping motion on any page (current in the schematic) and give everything else one authored moment from an already-visible default, eased on cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1).
Do restyle a borrowed app-shell control to the sheet's square, ruled form rather than forking a second component.
donts: Don't use the spot colour for decoration, section accents, or to make a surface feel branded. If you cannot name what is live, it is not blue.
Don't introduce a third ink, a third rule weight, or a corner radius.
Don't add a gradient, a glass or frosted panel, a blurred overlay, or a chip floated over artwork.
Don't add a second box-shadow. The plate lift is the whole vocabulary.
Don't treat data-sheet='blue' as a dark mode: no stock-specific layout, size, extra element, or softened weight.
Don't express the margin column in ch — it resolves against each element's own font and the column comes apart.
Don't set prose, headings or button labels in monospace to make them feel technical.
Don't stack a label above a heading. The labels in this system name a field, head a column, or identify a half of a figure; a kicker over a headline is not part of this world.
Don't use a glyph character or an icon font where a control's mark belongs; marks are stroked SVG on the sheet's own line.
Don't paint --plate-dark over a mount; the dark backing goes inside it.
Don't let a checkbox tick itself for something the visitor has not done.
